name: m2734-date
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, bright warm daylight. Close shot of one anonymous RIGHT hand picking up a single glossy brown date from a wooden bowl full of dates, the date held lightly between the thumb and two fingers just above the bowl. A round golden flat bread lies beside the bowl on a woven palm-leaf mat. Only the right hand and forearm in a plain undyed period sleeve are visible - no face, no head, no left hand. Exactly five fingers, natural proportions. Nothing is falling, no crumbs. Background softly blurred: a sunlit mud-brick wall and green date palms. Vibrant warm colours, no modern objects.
